description: fabro-890b/21c1: 'config never reaches resolve_pr_model' was an illusion — the affected runs executed on a stale server binary (0.335.0-nightly.1) that pre-dated the feature commit a1e27c9bf. The persisted spec blob always carried pull_request.model. FIRST CHECK for any 'configured value never arrives' bug: fabro dump <run> and read the executing version from events.jsonl (properties.version), before tracing serde/layering/persistence. Also: sd close for fabro-* seeds only works on the denkhaus (platform) branch — the lab worlds have their own trackers.
resolution: Verify the executing binary version from the run dump before suspecting persistence; deploy carries the feature (a1e27c9bf in 0.337.0-nightly.0); live run 01M0Z9WJGZ + PR #7 prove the PR model path end-to-end.
